en.bdb: Holy Congregation, the abode of truth

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦਹੁ ਸਬਦਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhahu sabadhahu baaharaa akath kathaa kiau(n) jihabaa jaanai|

en.bdb: The Lord is beyond taste and words; how can His ineffable story be told by tongue?

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ausatat ni(n)dhaa baaharaa kathanee badhanee vich na aanai|

en.bdb: He being beyond praise and slander does not come in the periphery of telling and hearing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਧ ਸਪਰਸੁ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਨਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)dh saparas agocharaa naas saas herat hairaanai|

en.bdb: He is beyond smell and touch and the nose, and the breath is also wonder-struck but cannot know Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਹੁ ਚਿਹਨਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: varanahu chihanahu baaharaa dhisaT adhisaT na dhiaan dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: He is away from any varna and symbolism and is even beyond the sight of concentration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਅਵਲੰਬ ਵਿਣੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: niraala(n)b avala(n)b vin dharat agaas nivaas viddaanai|

en.bdb: Without any prop He resides in the grandeur of earth and sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd hai nira(n)kaar gur sabadh sin(j)aanai|

en.bdb: Holy congregation is the abode of truth where through the word of the Guru, the formless Lord is recognised.
Whole of this creation is sacrifice unto the creator.
